# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Reactive

Optional derived state: IPropertyObservable, CombineLatest. System.Reactive is not required.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Reactive
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.6.1-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0 only. Not a MAUI TFM.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Reactive --prerelease

## Use this package when

- The user wants CombineLatest / property streams without taking System.Reactive in Core

## Do not use when

- They already use ReactiveUI — prefer that stack
- They only need SearchQuery debounce — that is Pagination

## Alternatives

ReactiveUI, System.Reactive, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm dependents.
